name: TaxAgency
description: A TaxAgency identifies the agency (entity) that collects taxes and to which a given tax rate applies.

fields.name: Id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this object. Required for update. Sort order is ASC by default.

fields.name: SyncToken
fields.description: Version number of the object. Required for update. Used to lock an object for use by one app at a time; incremented on each modification.

fields.name: TaxTrackedOnSales
fields.description: Denotes whether this tax agency is used to track tax on sales.

fields.name: TaxTrackedOnPurchases
fields.description: Denotes whether this tax agency is used to track tax on purchases.

fields.name: LastFileDate
fields.description: The last tax filing date for this tax agency. Automatically populated by QuickBooks business logic at tax filing time.

fields.name: MetaData
fields.description: Descriptive information about the entity. The MetaData values are set by Data Services and are read only for all applications.

attributes.name: LastUpdatedTime
attributes.description: Time the entity was last updated.

fields.name: TaxAgencyConfig
fields.description: Flag to identify whether the TaxAgency is system defined by the Automated Sales Tax engine or user generated.
